_why: The reputation lists show only the quest that PAYS reputation. Where that quest is the last part of a World Quest series, the earlier parts pay no reputation and so never appear — which makes a five-quest chain look like one short quest. The length tiers on those rows measure the final part alone and are wrong.
_limit: Detected by name. A quest gated behind a prerequisite with an unrelated name is not caught here — if a quest will not start in game, that is why, and it belongs in this file.
